title: Abangcatshi Babakhethiweyo
intro: Kuyo yonke imbali, abathunywa bakaThixo babehamba phakathi kwabantu, kwaye abanye babo basondeleyo kubo abazange bakuqonde ukukhanya. Le ngxelo ijikeleza kwimiphefumlo emibini eyaba luvavanyo lwabo lokuba kufutshane nomprofeti, kwaye ilifa labo lisisifundo esingapheliyo.
clues: Sasiphila ngamaxesha abaprofeti abakhulu, kodwa amehlo ethu ahlala evaliwe kwinyaniso abayizisayo.
Amakhaya ethu ayezaliswe sisityhilelo sikaThixo, kodwa iintliziyo zethu zazilukhuni.
Sasitshatile namadoda awayekhethwe ukuba alumkise abantu bawo.
Xa isohlwayo sifika, asizange sifune indawo yokukhosela emkhombeni okanye sibaleke imvula etshayo, kuba sahlekisa ngezilumkiso.
Sikhankanywa kwiQuran njengomzekelo kwabo bangakholwayo, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba nokuba nolwalamano olusondeleyo nomprofeti alusindisi.
Singabafazi bakaNuh noLut, ababangcatshayo baza bagwetywa ngaloo ndlela.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
